children: SAID ON THURSDAY IT COMPLETED SET-OFF ISSUE TO BONDHOLDERS AND DIRECTED SHARE ISSUES RESOLVED UPON BY EGM
SUBSCRIPTION PRICE IN SET-OFF ISSUE WAS SEK 1.00 PER SHARE
ALL SHARES IN SET-OFF ISSUE HAVE BEEN SUBSCRIBED FOR AND ALLOTTED

BOARD ALLOTTED SHARES IN THREE DIRECTED ISSUES TOTALING SEK 50.6 MILLION: SEK 31.7 MILLION TO PRS1 APS AND MB HOLDING KØGE APS THROUGH DEBT SET-OFF, SEK 7.5 MILLION TO PRS1 APS, AND SEK 11.4 MILLION TO CURRENT AND FORMER BOARD MEMBERS, INCLUDING SEK 0.2 MILLION THROUGH DEBT SET-OFF
